dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.text: Yaya ya yi wata sabuwar hanyar aiki, da kwarai ya sau ya koma gida?
dialogue.translation: How does he manage the new way of working, just quickly going home early?

dialogue.speaker: Zainab
dialogue.text: Ba zan fahimta ba. Amma ya yi ba'a gan shi da yau da kullum.
dialogue.translation: I don't understand that. But he doesn't work, and we don't see him every day.

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.text: Yaushe ya yi a cikin gida, ya ci abinci, sai ya bar wata wucewa.
dialogue.translation: He always works at home, eats, and then finishes just one task.

dialogue.speaker: Zainab
dialogue.text: Na tsammani wata matsaloli ne, ko da yaushe ya yi bashi a gida, sai ya meyasa abu da yaushe.
dialogue.translation: I think it's a problem, even if he works at home, he forgets things all the time.

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.text: Yaushe yaron ya kamata ya kasance da sabuwar hanyar aiki da wani sababbi.
dialogue.translation: It's always good that the son should have a new way of working for some reason.

dialogue.speaker: Zainab
dialogue.text: Amma ba zan yarda ba tare da sababbin wadanda ke daukar aiki a gida ba.
dialogue.translation: But I won't agree without knowing the people who take remote work.

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.text: Yaushe ya yi wajen sabon sabuwar hanyar aiki, amma saboda wadannan matsaloli ne.
dialogue.translation: He should always try the new way of working, but because of these problems.

dialogue.speaker: Zainab
dialogue.text: Bashi na yau da kullum ya kasance a gida, amma ba ne saboda yaushe ya kamata ya yi sabon wata.
dialogue.translation: The work is done at home every day, but it's not because he should always do something new.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wani dare na yau, zan fita da taka wajen gaske. Daga wani kwai, tun da yau zuwa gobe, zan gwada fadinsa.
dialogue.translation: One night tonight, I will come out with the truth about this. From a certain clan, from today until tomorrow, I will try to tell it.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Idan taka ce, zai sannu sabon dare. Amma wani miji ya fara yin gwargwad da mahaifiyarsa saboda taka.
dialogue.translation: If it is the truth, it will bring peace tonight. But some man started an argument with his wife because of the truth.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Na san cewa muna da wata matsalar da ba zan iya fad da ita ta yau ba.
dialogue.translation: I know that we have a problem that I cannot tell today.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: To, za mu tuna masa tun da yau zuwa wata rana. Ina gaskiya, wannan zai zama mai wahala.
dialogue.translation: So, we will remember it from today until some day. In truth, this will be difficult.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yaya zan iya fad da wannan? Ko zan iya fita da ba da sannu ko ba?
dialogue.translation: How can I tell this? Will I be able to come out without giving peace?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Idan taka ce, za a iya samun sannu. Amma wannan matsalar ba mai lafiya ce.
dialogue.translation: If it is the truth, peace can be achieved. But this problem is not healthy.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ina tunawa da wata rana saboda wannan kwai. Zan gwada abin da zan fad da su.
dialogue.translation: I am remembering one day because of this clan. I will try the thing that I will tell them.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: To, tunda muna da wahala, mu gwada abin da yake da shi. Ko wannan zai zama mai lafiya ko ba.
dialogue.translation: So, since we have difficulty, let us try the thing that is with it. Whether this will be healthy or not.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Akwai wasanni masu nuna madara a kan fasaha da ra'ayi daga waje, komai cikakken tsawon shekara.
dialogue.translation: There are games that show the impact of technology on opinions from outside, everything complete during a year.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Wane ne nan wasanni masu nuna madara kwarai? Daidai da farce ne kawai?
dialogue.translation: Which ones are these games that show impact exactly? Just an example or what?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kafin za mu fada, muna bukata da hasken da yake tattarawa a kan ra'ayoyi.
dialogue.translation: Before we explain, we need the truth that is being collected about opinions.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yaya za mu iya tabbatar da hasken wannan? Ba zan san amma ne saboda muke da ra'ayi daban-daban.
dialogue.translation: How can we confirm this truth? I don't know, but because we have different opinions.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cikakken bayanai da za a iya yin amfani dashi ne ya dogara.
dialogue.translation: Complete information that can be used is what it depends on.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: To, abin da ya kamata mu tuna shi shine madara da ke fadiwa a cikin fasaha.
dialogue.translation: Well, what we must remember is the influence that is being discussed in technology.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Madara ta da yawa ne kawai? Ko akwai wani sabon abun da zai shiga?
dialogue.translation: Is the influence a lot only? Or is there a new thing that will enter?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yaushe muna bukata ga sabis na sabuwar fasaha wajen ci girma-girma. A ciki kallo na, wannan shi ne damar mu.
dialogue.translation: We always need the new technology market to consume significant opportunities. In our view, this is our chance.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dole mu kama wata matsala tare da sabis sabuwa. Gaskiya, ba zan ci shi ba ne, amma zan ci yaushe.
dialogue.translation: We must tackle a new challenge alongside the market. Truly, I won’t consume it entirely, but I will always engage with it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Haka ko, mun yi bukatun yaushe ga fasahar sabuwa. Wannan shi ne sabis girma.
dialogue.translation: Yes, we always have needs for new technology. This is a huge market.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Idan muna bukata, za mu ci taswirar girma ta sabuwar fasaha. Ba zan ci ba ne, amma zan ci baya.
dialogue.translation: If we have needs, we will consume the blueprint of the new technology’s scale. I won’t consume it entirely, but I will consume it afterward.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kallo na shine, wannan fasahar sabuwa na mafi girma ga kasuwanci.
dialogue.translation: In my view, this new technology is the most important for business.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Gaskiya, haka ne. Kuma bayan wannan, za mu ci baya da sabis sabuwa.
dialogue.translation: Truly, that’s right. And after this, we will consume the market’s new opportunities afterward.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: To, muna da kallo mai girma wajen fasahar sabuwa. Wannan shine aiki.
dialogue.translation: So, we have a significant view toward the new technology. This is the work to be done.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yaushe, muna bukata ga fasahar sabuwa da sabis. Dole mu ci taswirar mu da girma.
dialogue.translation: Always, we need new technology and the market. We must consume our blueprint with scale.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Da kyau, ina juna a birnin Kano ko a kasar nan?
dialogue.translation: Well, do I live in Kano city or in this area?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kun juna a birnin ne, saboda karya da kasa da kallon yanzu matsakaici.
dialogue.translation: You live in the city because work and land here are modern.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Amma a kasar sabuwar nan, yawancin mutane suna karya da hannu tsaye.
dialogue.translation: But in the new countryside, most people do manual labor that's traditional.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Haka ne. A birnin, yawancin mutane suna nema kudi da kwararra, da kuma karya ce da kafi.
dialogue.translation: That's right. In the city, most people are always searching for money and entertainment, and their work is only sufficient.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: A kasar kwarai, mutane suna tsaya da tsaye, ko kuma suka ci gaba da nauyarsu.
dialogue.translation: In the countryside, people stand firm and traditional, or they go forward with their farming.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: To, wannan dukkanin karya da kallon ya yi dalili ga mutane, wata duniya ce.
dialogue.translation: Yes, all this work and change causes reasons for people—it's a different world.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: To, shin kun sanin yadda yawancin mutane suna rayuwarsa a dukkanin duniya, ko karya ko kasar?
dialogue.translation: Yes, do you know how most people live in the world, whether in work or land?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Haka ne. Da wannan karya ko kasa, mutane suna rayuwarsa da yawa a yau.
dialogue.translation: That's right. With this work or land, people live with many things today.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Ana nuna sabon tsari na rashin kwangila da kewayar yausa, ba wata matsaloli ba ce. Yausa, zan shiga daga sabon tsari na rashin kwangila.
dialogue.translation: A new anti-pollution policy is being proposed, it's not a minor issue. Then, I will support the new anti-pollution policy.

dialogue.speaker: Halima
dialogue.text: Idan baku tattauna wata sabon tsari ba, to wace tambaya ce. Wata sabon tsari daga yara da yara ba zai wuce wajen sabon tsari ba.
dialogue.translation: If we don't discuss a new policy, what question is there? A new policy from young people won't exceed the current policy.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Wata sabon tsari wajen rubutu ba zai jya baya saboda zai rage kwayoyin iyawar yara. Wajen rubutu, mutane zasu ji sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon.
dialogue.translation: A new policy on paper won't still reach reducing youth poverty. On paper, people will only feel new policies.

dialogue.speaker: Halima
dialogue.text: To, daga wajen rubutu ba zai tsaya ba. Don Allah, mu tsaya tsaya da sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon.
dialogue.translation: Yes, it won't stop at just being on paper. I implore, let's stop and stick with the current policy for now.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Ba zan tsaya ba! Idan muna tsaya tsaya, rashin iyawa zai gama da kasa ba wannan shekara ba.
dialogue.translation: I won't stop! If we keep stopping, poverty will overtake the country this year.

dialogue.speaker: Halima
dialogue.text: To, zan ba ka sabon tsari saboda zan tsaya tsaya da sabon tsari na kwanaki biyu.
dialogue.translation: Okay, I won't give you a new policy because I will stick with the current policy for two more days.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Idan ba zan samu sabon tsari ba, zan yi yausa da shiga wajen sabon tsari na rashin kwangila.
dialogue.translation: If I don't get a new policy, I will then support the anti-pollution policy.

dialogue.speaker: Halima
dialogue.text: To, zan tsaya da sabon tsari da yausa. Idan ba mu tsaya ba, rashin iyawa za ta gama da kasa.
dialogue.translation: Okay, I will stick with the current policy then. If we don't stop, poverty will overtake the country.

dialogue.text: Yausa, ina son koma gida da yawon koyaushe. Wata rai ne da nufi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Koyaushe muna yarda da wucewa a cikin al’ada na jama’a, amma wasu sassan sun isa.

dialogue.text: To, farin koyi ne wannan. Ko dai, sababbir da na nuna shine cewa ba ko da ƙarfi da mutane da ke kamar wannan suka fara a kan girma.
dialogue.translation: Yes, that's an obvious tradition. Or rather, the reasons I've shown indicate that those without power often start from a position of weakness.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Na san daidai. Akwai wata shirya da ake buƙata, amma ba mai ƙarfi da ya shirya saboda ya ke tana da matsakaicin yaɗa.
dialogue.translation: Exactly right. There's a plan that's needed, but those with power don't prepare because they're stuck in their ways.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yaushe, muna da wani sababbi ko wani abu da ya shirya hali na wannan. Ko dai, sun kwana da wata sababbi ce ta ba da ƙarfi ga dukan mutane.
dialogue.translation: Always, there's a reason or something that causes this situation. Or rather, they've stayed with a reason that gives power to some people.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wannan ya ke nuna cewa mutane da suka yi ƙarfi sun fara a kan girma da daidai saboda suka shirya hali na musamman.
dialogue.translation: This shows that people who have power started from a position of strength because they created a specific system.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Akwai wata sababbi da ke ba da ƙarfi ga wanda ya fara a kan farin halin da ya ke. Amma za mu sabunta wannan saboda mu san cewa farin hali ne sababbin mutane.
dialogue.translation: There's a reason that gives power to those who start from a position of clear advantage. But we'll correct this because we know the clear situation is the cause for some people.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wataƙila, mu shirya sabis na sabunta hali ne da zai ba da ƙarfi ga dukan mutane ko da yaushe.
dialogue.translation: Perhaps, we should prepare a system to correct the situation so it gives power to everyone always.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: To, wannan shine abin da zai faru ko da yaushe. Ba zan yi wani abu ko ba zan barin wata sababbi da ke nuna cewa hali na girma ne saboda sababbi.
dialogue.translation: Yes, that's what should happen always. I won't do anything or leave a reason that shows our situation is strong because of these causes.

key_phrases.translation: We have a problem here, right?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yaushe muna nunawa ƙarfinsa da dama a wani tsararra? Daidai, ya kamata muna nunawa ƙarfinsa a tsararra.
dialogue.translation: Do we always show strength sufficiently in such a situation? Exactly, we must show our strength in such a situation.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Amm, tana ƙarfinsa da farin cika wata rayuwarsa. Ba za ta wuce ba, ko da yaushe ta tsaya a matsayinsa.
dialogue.translation: Well, she shows her strength with clear fullness in her life. She doesn't exceed it, and always stands in her position.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yanzu, nawa ne sabon hali na shugabanci mai ƙauna wanda yake ci gaba?
dialogue.translation: Now, how much is the new style of leadership that leads with love?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Juna yaushe da ƙarfinsa kansa, amma ba kan ƙauna ba kawai. Ya dace da sabis daga wasu abubuwan rayuwarsa.
dialogue.translation: They always have strength themselves, but not just love. It depends on other things in their life.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: To, ƙauna da ƙarfi kalubale ne kawai, ko da yaushe ya kamata ya tsaya daidai da rayuwarsa.
dialogue.translation: So, love and strength are not enough, and always one must stand exactly according to their life.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Daidai, wata ƙarfi ce da yawa, amma duk wannan yana da farin cika, ko kuma ƙauna.
dialogue.translation: Exactly, strength is much, but all this has clear fullness, or also love.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yanzu, nawa ne sabar da ake buƙaci wani sabon tsararra da ƙarfi mai yawa?
dialogue.translation: Now, how much patience is needed for a new situation with much strength?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dama, amma ba kawai sabar, ko ƙauna da ƙarfi daidai su ne ke ci gaba daya.
dialogue.translation: Enough, but not just patience, love and strength exactly are what lead together.
